learning_outcomes.text: To possess knowledge of fundamental physical laws and their application in engineering.
To provide students with a detailed understanding of fundamental concepts and principles related to mechanics.
To ensure understanding of these principles and concepts by demonstrating their use in daily life and engineering applications.
To bring students to a level where they can use this information in specialized departmental courses.
To equip students with analytical thinking ability.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, measurement methods, errors and calculations.
Physical quantities, scalar and vector quantities.
Vector operations, addition, subtraction and multiplication.
Center of gravity and equilibrium equations.
Curvilinear motion, motion in a plane, velocity, acceleration, tangential acceleration.
Principles of dynamics and Newton's laws of motion.
Definition of friction and friction forces.
Capacitance and capacitors, resistors and connections.
DC circuits, Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's laws.
